item.title: Finding your way in the metro
item.context_text: You are on holiday in a big city. You are at Central station in the metro. You want to go to the City Museum, and your friend Timur wants to meet you there.
item.objective_text: Read the metro sign, ask for help, understand the answer, and tell your friend the way.
item.target_grammar: imperatives for directions (Take line 2. Get off at…)
item.cultural_note: Metro workers in big cities are used to tourists. A short question like "Excuse me, which platform for the museum?" is enough.
success_conditions: Find the right station and the ticket price on the sign
Ask a metro worker for help
Tell your friend which line, which platform and where to get off

children.title: Read the metro sign
children.instructions: Read the sign on the wall. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
METRO — LINE 2 (green)
Central → Park Street → River Bridge → Museum Square → Airport
Trains every 5 minutes.
Ticket: 2 euros.
Buy tickets at the machines. The machines take cards and coins.

questions.prompt: Which station is near the museum?
questions.explanation: The station for the museum is Museum Square.

questions.prompt: How often do the trains come?

children.title: Ask a metro worker
children.instructions: You can't find the right platform. A metro worker comes to help. Say where you want to go and ask a question.
children.prompt_text: Metro worker: Hello. Can I help you?
children.goal: Say where you want to go and ask which way.

points.label: say where you want to go

children.model_answer: Yes, please. I want to go to the City Museum. Which platform is it?

children.title: Listen to the metro worker
children.instructions: Listen to the metro worker. Then answer the questions. You can listen again.
children.prompt_text: The museum? Take the green line, line two. Go down the stairs to platform three. It is three stops: Park Street, River Bridge, then Museum Square. Get off there. The museum is across the road.

questions.explanation: The worker says "Go down the stairs to platform three."
"It is three stops: Park Street, River Bridge, then Museum Square."

children.title: Tell your friend the way
children.instructions: Timur is at Central station too. Write a message. Tell him the line, the platform and where to get off.
children.prompt_text: Timur: I'm at Central station too. How do I get to the museum?
children.goal: Tell Timur how to get to the museum by metro.
children.model_answer: Hi Timur! Take the green line, line 2, from platform 3. Go three stops and get off at Museum Square. The museum is across the road. See you there!
